title: ScamShield product and evidence updates
description: Human-curated releases from ScamShield. This feed never contains private review-queue records, submitted messages, or exact IOC values.

items.title: ScamShield strengthens real-time Telegram monitoring and recovery
items.summary: The configured-source monitor now uses a bounded live queue, parallel recovery across independent sources, immediate retry after graceful restarts, independent source-refresh and candidate-verification loops, and a private aggregate health view. Public-source expansion runs every 30 minutes but still requires Telegram verification and corroboration from at least two configured sources. The authorization boundary remains limited to public or explicitly operator-authorized Telegram sources.

_scamshield.disclosure: Only aggregate operational behavior is described; no watched source identity, submitted message, Telegram identity, exact IOC value, or private review-queue record is included.

items.title: ScamShield adds honest non-text handling and privacy-safe verdict feedback
items.summary: Photos, screenshots, voice notes, PDFs and other unsupported non-text submissions now receive an explicit text-only limitation instead of silence. Private verdicts offer one-tap useful, wrong and unsure feedback; ScamShield stores only the opaque assessment reference, original tier and selected response. Aggregate campaign and unsupported-input counts help prioritize the next adapters without retaining Telegram identities or message contents. Guardian mode remains off by default and its dormant moderation policy is now flag-only.

_scamshield.disclosure: Only aggregate product-event counts and opaque feedback fields are described; no submitted message, Telegram identity, exact IOC value, or private review-queue record is included.

items.title: ScamShield publishes a public message-checking and interpretation guide
items.summary: The public guide gives ScamShield by Palimpsest a stable, crawlable identity outside Telegram. It explains how to submit a suspicious message, what supported pattern matches do and do not prove, the privacy boundary, and the official Indian cyber-fraud reporting route. The bot now links back to the same guide.

_scamshield.disclosure: No submitted message, exact IOC value, or private review-queue record is included.

items.title: ScamShield adds privacy-safe REST and MCP assessment surfaces
items.summary: Developers can now run the same evidence-bounded message triage contract over a loopback REST API or local MCP server. Assessments are processed in memory, never enter the IOC or review stores, never invoke the Palimpsest bridge, and omit submitted text and exact IOC values from responses. The Telegram bot also gains clearer how-it-works, typology, privacy, and product-discovery commands.

_scamshield.disclosure: No submitted message, exact IOC value, or private review-queue record is included.
